items.question: What B2B lead generation services do you offer?
items.answer: We offer seven core services: LinkedIn Outreach and Automation, Cold Email Infrastructure, ICP Mapping and Lead Scoring, AI-Led Lead Generation, Account-Based Marketing, Personal Branding, and GTM Strategy. Each service is productized and runs on proven systems.

items.question: How is AI used in your lead generation services?
items.answer: Our AI agents research, qualify, and prioritize leads at scale, cutting manual research time by 80%. We also use AI for personalization in cold email and LinkedIn sequences, ensuring every outreach feels human and relevant.

items.question: Do you work with B2B companies outside Mumbai?
items.answer: Yes. While we are based in Mumbai, we serve B2B companies across India and internationally. Our systems work remotely and integrate with your existing tools.
